title: Missing content-security-policy
rationale: content-security-policy absent on 200 HTTP response. Review in application context; absence does not demonstrate exploitability.
remediation: Constrain script/resource origins with a tested Content-Security-Policy.

title: Missing x-content-type-options
rationale: x-content-type-options absent on 200 HTTP response. Review in application context; absence does not demonstrate exploitability.
remediation: Set X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff.

title: Cookie session: Secure absent
rationale: Cookie session has a session-like name and no Secure attribute. The name is a heuristic, not proof of authentication use.
remediation: Set Secure on session cookies and serve the application over HTTPS.

title: Cookie session: HttpOnly absent
rationale: Cookie session has no HttpOnly attribute; actual use requires analyst verification.
remediation: Set HttpOnly unless client-side access is explicitly required.

title: Cookie session: SameSite review
rationale: Cookie session: SameSite=None, Secure=False. Browser defaults and cross-site requirements affect risk.
remediation: Choose Lax or Strict where possible; SameSite=None requires Secure.
